prompt:
# Segment 1 (0-11.7s) - Introduction to right triangles
title = Text("Trigonometry", font_size=48).to_edge(UP)
subtitle = Text("Relationships in Right Triangles", font_size=36).next_to(title, DOWN)

triangle = Polygon(
    ORIGIN, RIGHT*3, UP*2,
    color=WHITE,
    fill_opacity=0.2
)
right_angle = Square(side_length=0.3).move_to(triangle.get_vertices()[0]).shift(RIGHT*0.15 + UP*0.15)

self.play(Write(title), run_time=2)
self.play(Write(subtitle), run_time=2)
self.play(Create(triangle), Create(right_angle), run_time=3)
self.wait(4.7)

# Segment 2 (11.7-32.0s) - Defining sides
hyp_label = Text("Hypotenuse", color=YELLOW, font_size=24)
hyp_label.next_to(triangle.get_center(), UR)
hyp_arrow = Arrow(hyp_label.get_left(), triangle.get_center(), color=YELLOW)

hyp_line = Line(triangle.get_vertices()[1], triangle.get_vertices()[2], color=YELLOW)

self.play(
    FadeOut(title),
    FadeOut(subtitle),
    triangle.animate.shift(LEFT*2),
    right_angle.animate.shift(LEFT*2),
    run_time=2
)
self.play(
    Create(hyp_arrow),
    Write(hyp_label),
    Transform(triangle.get_subcurve(0.6, 0.9), hyp_line),
    run_time=3
)
self.wait(15.3)

# Segment 3 (32.0-45.2s) - Opposite and adjacent
angle = Arc(radius=0.5, angle=triangle.get_angle(), color=RED)
angle.shift(LEFT*2)
theta = MathTex(r"\theta", color=RED).next_to(angle, RIGHT, buff=0.1)

opp_label = Text("Opposite", color=BLUE, font_size=24).next_to(triangle, LEFT)
adj_label = Text("Adjacent", color=GREEN, font_size=24).next_to(triangle, DOWN)

self.play(Create(angle), Write(theta), run_time=2)
self.play(
    Write(opp_label),
    Write(adj_label),
    triangle.animate.set_color_by_gradient(BLUE, GREEN),
    run_time=3
)
self.wait(8.2)

# Segment 4 (45.2-63.0s) - First three ratios
sine_ratio = MathTex(r"\sin \theta = \frac{\text{opposite}}{\text{hypotenuse}}", color=YELLOW)
sine_ratio.to_edge(RIGHT)

self.play(Write(sine_ratio), run_time=3)
self.wait(14.8)

# Segment 5 (63.0-80.7s) - SOH CAH TOA
soh_cah_toa = VGroup(
    MathTex(r"\text{SOH: } \sin \theta = \frac{\text{opp}}{\text{hyp}}", color=YELLOW),
    MathTex(r"\text{CAH: } \cos \theta = \frac{\text{adj}}{\text{hyp}}", color=BLUE),
    MathTex(r"\text{TOA: } \tan \theta = \frac{\text{opp}}{\text{adj}}", color=GREEN)
).arrange(DOWN, buff=0.5).to_edge(RIGHT)

self.play(
    ReplacementTransform(sine_ratio, soh_cah_toa[0]),
    run_time=2
)
self.play(Write(soh_cah_toa[1:]), run_time=3)
self.wait(12.8)

# Segment 6 (80.7-99.0s) - Reciprocal ratios
recip_ratios = VGroup(
    MathTex(r"\csc \theta = \frac{1}{\sin \theta} = \frac{\text{hyp}}{\text{opp}}", color=YELLOW),
    MathTex(r"\sec \theta = \frac{1}{\cos \theta} = \frac{\text{hyp}}{\text{adj}}", color=BLUE),
    MathTex(r"\cot \theta = \frac{1}{\tan \theta} = \frac{\text{adj}}{\text{opp}}", color=GREEN)
).arrange(DOWN, buff=0.5).to_edge(RIGHT)

self.play(
    FadeOut(soh_cah_toa),
    run_time=1
)
self.play(Write(recip_ratios), run_time=4)
self.wait(13.3)

# Segment 7 (99.0-104.1s) - Summary
final_text = Text("These ratios are fundamental\nto triangle problems", font_size=36)
final_text.move_to(RIGHT*3)

self.play(
    Write(final_text),
    run_time=2
)
self.wait(3.1)

section_title: Finding All Ratios from a Single Given Ratio
prompt:
# Segment 1 (0-15.7s) - Introduction
title = Text("Finding All Trig Ratios from One Ratio", font_size=40).to_edge(UP)
given = MathTex(r"\tan A = \frac{4}{3}").scale(1.2)
self.play(Write(title), run_time=2)
self.play(FadeIn(given), run_time=2)
self.wait(11.7)

# Segment 2 (15.7-29.5s) - Drawing right triangle
triangle = Polygon(
    ORIGIN, RIGHT*3, UP*4,
    color=WHITE
).shift(DOWN + LEFT*1.5)
right_angle = Square(side_length=0.3).next_to(triangle.get_vertices()[0], UR, buff=0)
angle_A = Arc(radius=0.5, angle=math.atan(4/3), color=YELLOW)
angle_A.shift(triangle.get_vertices()[0])
angle_label = MathTex("A").next_to(angle_A, RIGHT, buff=0.1)

self.play(FadeOut(given), run_time=1)
self.play(Create(triangle), run_time=3)
self.play(
    Create(right_angle),
    Create(angle_A),
    Write(angle_label),
    run_time=3
)
self.wait(6.7)

# Segment 3 (29.5-47.2s) - Labeling sides
opp_label = MathTex("4").next_to(triangle.get_vertices()[1], RIGHT)
adj_label = MathTex("3").next_to(triangle.get_vertices()[0], DOWN)
opp_brace = Brace(Line(triangle.get_vertices()[0], triangle.get_vertices()[1]), RIGHT)
adj_brace = Brace(Line(triangle.get_vertices()[0], triangle.get_vertices()[2]), DOWN)

self.play(
    Create(opp_brace),
    Create(adj_brace),
    Write(opp_label),
    Write(adj_label),
    run_time=3
)
self.wait(14.8)

# Segment 4 (47.2-66.0s) - Pythagorean theorem
pyth = MathTex(r"c^2 = a^2 + b^2").to_edge(RIGHT)
self.play(Write(pyth), run_time=2)
values = MathTex(r"c^2 = 4^2 + 3^2").next_to(pyth, DOWN)
self.play(Write(values), run_time=2)
self.wait(14.8)

# Segment 5 (66.0-83.8s) - Finding hypotenuse
calc1 = MathTex(r"c^2 = 16 + 9 = 25").next_to(values, DOWN)
calc2 = MathTex(r"c = 5").next_to(calc1, DOWN)
hyp_label = MathTex("5").next_to(Line(triangle.get_vertices()[1], triangle.get_vertices()[2]).get_center(), UP+LEFT)
hyp_brace = Brace(Line(triangle.get_vertices()[1], triangle.get_vertices()[2]), UP+LEFT)

self.play(Write(calc1), run_time=2)
self.play(Write(calc2), run_time=2)
self.play(
    Create(hyp_brace),
    Write(hyp_label),
    run_time=2
)
self.wait(11.8)

# Segment 6 (83.8-99.5s) - Sine and cosine
sine = MathTex(r"\sin A = \frac{4}{5}").to_edge(RIGHT).shift(UP)
cosine = MathTex(r"\cos A = \frac{3}{5}").next_to(sine, DOWN)

self.play(
    FadeOut(pyth), FadeOut(values),
    FadeOut(calc1), FadeOut(calc2),
    run_time=1
)
self.play(Write(sine), run_time=2)
self.play(Write(cosine), run_time=2)
self.wait(10.7)

# Segment 7 (99.5-115.8s) - Reciprocal ratios
csc = MathTex(r"\csc A = \frac{5}{4}").next_to(cosine, DOWN)
sec = MathTex(r"\sec A = \frac{5}{3}").next_to(csc, DOWN)
cot = MathTex(r"\cot A = \frac{3}{4}").next_to(sec, DOWN)

self.play(Write(csc), run_time=2)
self.play(Write(sec), run_time=2)
self.play(Write(cot), run_time=2)
self.wait(10.2)

# Segment 8 (115.8-134.5s) - Summary
summary_box = SurroundingRectangle(VGroup(sine, cosine, csc, sec, cot))
self.play(Create(summary_box), run_time=2)
self.play(
    Indicate(triangle),
    Indicate(VGroup(opp_label, adj_label, hyp_label)),
    run_time=3
)
self.wait(13.8)

section_title: Proving Angle Equality Using Sine Ratios
prompt:
# Segment 1 (0-8.6s) - Introduction
title = Text("Proving Angle Equality Using Trigonometry", font_size=40).to_edge(UP)
self.play(Write(title), run_time=3)
self.wait(5.6)

# Segment 2 (8.6-27.4s) - State the problem
problem = MathTex(r"\text{If }\sin B = \sin Q\text{, then }B = Q").next_to(title, DOWN)
self.play(Write(problem), run_time=3)
self.wait(15.8)

# Segment 3 (27.4-43.2s) - Display triangles
# First triangle
triangle1_points = [
    np.array([-3, -2, 0]),
    np.array([-3, 0, 0]), 
    np.array([-1, -2, 0])
]
triangle1 = Polygon(*triangle1_points, color=BLUE)
angle_B = Arc(radius=0.4, angle=PI/3, start_angle=0, color=YELLOW)
angle_B_label = MathTex("B").next_to(angle_B, RIGHT, buff=0.1)
right_angle1 = Square(side_length=0.2).next_to(triangle1_points[1], DL, buff=0)

# Second triangle
triangle2_points = [
    np.array([1, -2, 0]),
    np.array([1, 0, 0]),
    np.array([3, -2, 0])
]
triangle2 = Polygon(*triangle2_points, color=RED)
angle_Q = Arc(radius=0.4, angle=PI/3, start_angle=0, color=YELLOW)
angle_Q_label = MathTex("Q").next_to(angle_Q, RIGHT, buff=0.1)
right_angle2 = Square(side_length=0.2).next_to(triangle2_points[1], DL, buff=0)

self.play(
    Create(triangle1),
    Create(triangle2),
    Create(angle_B),
    Create(angle_Q),
    Write(angle_B_label),
    Write(angle_Q_label),
    Create(right_angle1),
    Create(right_angle2),
    run_time=4
)
self.wait(11.7)

# Segment 4 (43.2-66.0s) - Show sine ratio definition
sine_def = MathTex(r"\sin \theta = \frac{\text{opposite}}{\text{hypotenuse}}")
sine_eq = MathTex(r"\sin B = \sin Q \Rightarrow \frac{a}{c} = \frac{p}{r}")
VGroup(sine_def, sine_eq).arrange(DOWN).next_to(problem, DOWN, buff=0.5)

self.play(Write(sine_def), run_time=3)
self.play(Write(sine_eq), run_time=3)
self.wait(16.9)

# Segment 5 (66.0-91.4s) - Introduce k and Pythagorean theorem
k_prop = MathTex(r"\frac{a}{p} = \frac{c}{r} = k").next_to(sine_eq, DOWN)
pyth = MathTex(r"a^2 + b^2 = c^2").next_to(k_prop, DOWN)
pyth2 = MathTex(r"p^2 + q^2 = r^2").next_to(pyth, DOWN)

self.play(Write(k_prop), run_time=3)
self.play(Write(pyth), Write(pyth2), run_time=3)
self.wait(19.4)

# Segment 6 (91.4-110.2s) - Conclude similarity
conclusion = Text("Triangles are similar ⟹ Angles are equal", font_size=36)
conclusion.next_to(pyth2, DOWN, buff=0.5)
self.play(Write(conclusion), run_time=3)
self.wait(15.8)

# Segment 7 (110.2-120.3s) - Summary
summary_box = SurroundingRectangle(VGroup(title, conclusion), buff=0.3, color=GREEN)
self.play(Create(summary_box), run_time=2)
self.wait(8.2)

# Segment 1 (0-18.8s) - Introduction
title = Text("Finding Trigonometric Ratios", font_size=40).to_edge(UP)
given = MathTex(r"\tan A = \frac{4}{3}").scale(1.2)
goal = Text("Goal: Find all trig ratios", font_size=32).next_to(given, DOWN, buff=0.5)

self.play(Write(title), run_time=2)
self.wait(2)
self.play(FadeIn(given), run_time=2)
self.wait(2)
self.play(Write(goal), run_time=2)
self.wait(8.8)

# Segment 2 (18.8-40.1s) - Drawing triangle
triangle = Polygon(
    ORIGIN, RIGHT*3, RIGHT*3 + UP*4,
    color=WHITE
).scale(0.8).shift(LEFT*2 + DOWN)

right_angle = Square(side_length=0.3, color=WHITE).scale(0.8)
right_angle.next_to(triangle.get_vertices()[0], UR, buff=0)

labels = VGroup(
    MathTex("A").next_to(triangle.get_vertices()[2], UL),
    MathTex("B").next_to(triangle.get_vertices()[0], DL),
    MathTex("C").next_to(triangle.get_vertices()[1], DR),
    MathTex("4").next_to(triangle.get_right(), RIGHT),
    MathTex("3").next_to(triangle.get_bottom(), DOWN)
)

self.play(FadeOut(given, goal), run_time=1.5)
self.play(Create(triangle), run_time=3)
self.play(Create(right_angle), run_time=1.5)
self.play(Write(labels), run_time=3)
self.wait(12.3)

# Segment 3 (40.1-59.9s) - Pythagorean theorem
pythag = VGroup(
    MathTex(r"AC^2 = AB^2 + BC^2"),
    MathTex(r"AC^2 = 3^2 + 4^2"),
    MathTex(r"AC^2 = 9 + 16"),
    MathTex(r"AC^2 = 25")
).arrange(DOWN, buff=0.4).shift(RIGHT*3)

self.play(Write(pythag[0]), run_time=2)
self.wait(2)
self.play(Write(pythag[1]), run_time=2)
self.wait(2)
self.play(Write(pythag[2]), run_time=2)
self.wait(2)
self.play(Write(pythag[3]), run_time=2)
self.wait(7.8)

# Segment 4 (59.9-75.1s) - Finding hypotenuse
hyp_label = MathTex("5").next_to(
    Line(triangle.get_vertices()[0], triangle.get_vertices()[2]).get_center(),
    UL, buff=0.2
)
hyp_calc = MathTex(r"AC = \sqrt{25} = 5").next_to(pythag, DOWN, buff=0.5)

self.play(Write(hyp_calc), run_time=2)
self.wait(2)
self.play(FadeIn(hyp_label), run_time=2)
self.wait(9.2)

# Segment 5 (75.1-112.7s) - All trig ratios
ratios = VGroup(
    MathTex(r"\sin A = \frac{4}{5}"),
    MathTex(r"\cos A = \frac{3}{5}"),
    MathTex(r"\csc A = \frac{5}{4}"),
    MathTex(r"\sec A = \frac{5}{3}"),
    MathTex(r"\cot A = \frac{3}{4}")
).arrange(DOWN, buff=0.4).shift(RIGHT*3)

self.play(FadeOut(pythag, hyp_calc), run_time=1.5)
self.play(Write(ratios[0]), run_time=2)
self.wait(6)
self.play(Write(ratios[1]), run_time=2)
self.wait(6)
self.play(Write(ratios[2]), run_time=2)
self.wait(6)
self.play(Write(ratios[3]), run_time=2)
self.wait(6)
self.play(Write(ratios[4]), run_time=2)
self.wait(2.1)

# Segment 1 (0-10.7s) - Introduction
title = Text("Finding Trigonometric Ratios\nfrom Side Relationships", font_size=40).to_edge(UP)
self.play(Write(title), run_time=3)
self.wait(7.7)

# Segment 2 (10.7-22.8s) - Given tangent ratio
given_eq = MathTex(r"\tan A = \frac{4}{3}", font_size=48).shift(UP)
self.play(Write(given_eq), run_time=2.5)
box = SurroundingRectangle(given_eq, color=YELLOW)
self.play(Create(box), run_time=1)
self.wait(8.7)

# Segment 3 (22.8-45.2s) - Drawing triangle
# Create triangle points
A = np.array([-2, -1, 0])
B = np.array([1, -1, 0]) 
C = np.array([-2, 2, 0])
triangle = Polygon(A, B, C, color=WHITE)

# Labels
angle_A = Arc(radius=0.4, angle=PI/3, start_angle=0, color=YELLOW).shift(A)
angle_label = MathTex("A", font_size=36).next_to(angle_A, RIGHT, buff=0.1)
opp_label = MathTex("4", font_size=36).next_to(C, LEFT)
adj_label = MathTex("3", font_size=36).next_to(B, DOWN)
right_angle = RightAngle(Line(B,A), Line(B,C), length=0.3)

self.play(
    FadeOut(box),
    given_eq.animate.to_edge(UP),
    Create(triangle),
    run_time=3
)
self.play(
    Create(angle_A),
    Write(angle_label),
    Create(right_angle),
    run_time=2
)
self.play(
    Write(opp_label),
    Write(adj_label),
    run_time=2
)
self.wait(15.3)

# Segment 4 (45.2-68.0s) - Pythagorean theorem
pyth_eq = MathTex(r"4^2 + 3^2 = c^2", font_size=42).shift(DOWN * 2)
pyth_calc = MathTex(r"16 + 9 = 25", font_size=42).next_to(pyth_eq, DOWN)
hyp_result = MathTex(r"c = 5", font_size=42).next_to(pyth_calc, DOWN)
hyp_label = MathTex("5", font_size=36).next_to(Line(A,C).get_center(), RIGHT)

self.play(Write(pyth_eq), run_time=3)
self.play(Write(pyth_calc), run_time=3)
self.play(Write(hyp_result), run_time=2)
self.play(Write(hyp_label), run_time=2)
self.wait(12.9)

# Segment 5 (68.0-121.3s) - All trig ratios
ratios = VGroup(
    MathTex(r"\sin A = \frac{4}{5}", font_size=36),
    MathTex(r"\cos A = \frac{3}{5}", font_size=36),
    MathTex(r"\csc A = \frac{5}{4}", font_size=36),
    MathTex(r"\sec A = \frac{5}{3}", font_size=36),
    MathTex(r"\cot A = \frac{3}{4}", font_size=36)
).arrange(DOWN, buff=0.4).to_edge(RIGHT)

for i, ratio in enumerate(ratios):
    self.play(Write(ratio), run_time=2)
    self.wait(8.66)

# Final wait to complete segment
self.wait(5.3)
